AssignLeniPrivateIpAddress.description_en: Assign a secondary private IP address to the specified Lingjun Elastic Network Interface (ENI). You can optionally let the system auto-assign the IP address
AssignLeniPrivateIpAddress.description_zh: 为当前的灵骏弹性网卡申请辅助私网IP（可选自动分配辅助私网IP）

AssignPrivateIpAddress.description_en: Applies for a private secondary IP address for the current LNI. You can also call this operation to assign a secondary MAC address to the current LNI
AssignPrivateIpAddress.description_zh: 为当前的灵骏网卡申请辅助私网IP，以及可选自动分配辅助Mac地址

AssociateVpdCidrBlock.description_en: When the VPD primary network segment address is not enough to allocate, you can choose to create an additional network segment as the additional network segment of the VPD primary network segment
AssociateVpdCidrBlock.description_zh: 当VPD主网段地址不够分配的时候，可以选择创建额外的附加网段作为VPD主网段的附加网段

AttachElasticNetworkInterface.description_en: Attaches an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) to a node

CreateElasticNetworkInterface.description_en: Creates a Lingjun Elastic Network Interface (ENI)

CreateErRouteMap.description_en: Users can use this API to create routing policy by specifying the network instance connection under Lingjun HUB
CreateErRouteMap.description_zh: 用户可以使用该API，通过指定灵骏HUB下的网络实例连接，创建路由策略

CreateSubnet.description_en: Users can use this API to create a Lingjun subnet under the Lingjun network segment
CreateSubnet.description_zh: 用户可以使用该API在灵骏网段下创建一个灵骏子网

CreateVcc.description_en: You can create a Lingjun connection to connect Lingjun network environment and Alibaba Cloud network environment
CreateVcc.description_zh: 用户可创建灵骏连接，用于连通灵骏网络环境和阿里云网络环境

CreateVccGrantRule.description_en: Users can use this API to connect Lingjun instance to the Lingjun HUB instance of the target account. After authorization, the target account can be associated with your Lingjun connection by using the authorized Lingjun HUB instance
CreateVccGrantRule.description_zh: 用户可通过此API，将灵骏连接实例对目标账号的灵骏HUB实例授权。授权后，目标账号即可用被授权的灵骏HUB实例关联到您的灵骏连接

CreateVccRouteEntry.description_en: Create a Lingjun connection route entry
CreateVccRouteEntry.description_zh: 创建灵骏连接路由条目

CreateVpd.description_en: Create a private Lingjun CIDR block. This CIDR block has an independent network environment
CreateVpd.description_zh: 创建用户私有的灵骏网段，该网段拥有独立的网络环境

CreateVpdGrantRule.description_en: Users can use this API to authorize Lingjun HUB instances of the target account. After authorization, the target account can be associated with your Lingjun CIDR block by using the authorized Lingjun HUB instance
CreateVpdGrantRule.description_zh: 用户可通过此API，将灵骏网段实例对目标账号的灵骏HUB实例授权。授权后，目标账号即可用被授权的灵骏HUB实例关联到您的灵骏网段

DeleteElasticNetworkInterface.description_en: Delete a Lingjun elastic network interface (ENI). All associated data is permanently lost and cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution
DeleteElasticNetworkInterface.description_zh: 删除灵骏弹性网卡，删除后，相关数据全部丢失且不可恢复，请谨慎操作

DeleteEr.description_en: After you delete a Lingjun HUB instance, the related data is lost and cannot be recovered
DeleteEr.description_zh: 删除某个灵骏HUB实例，删除后相关数据丢失且不可恢复

DeleteErAttachment.description_en: If you delete a network instance that is connected to an instance, the related data is lost and cannot be recovered
DeleteErAttachment.description_zh: 删除某个网络实例连接实例，删除后相关数据丢失且不可恢复

DeleteErRouteMap.description_en: If you delete a routing policy instance, the related data is lost and cannot be recovered
DeleteErRouteMap.description_zh: 删除某个路由策略实例，删除后相关数据丢失且不可恢复

DeleteSubnet.description_en: If you delete a Lingjun subnet instance, the related data is lost and cannot be recovered
DeleteSubnet.description_zh: 删除某个灵骏子网实例，删除后相关数据丢失且不可恢复

DeleteVccGrantRule.description_en: If you delete a Lingjun HUB cross-account authorization that is connected to Lingjun, the related data is lost and cannot be recovered
DeleteVccGrantRule.description_zh: 删除某个灵骏连接的灵骏HUB跨账号授权，删除后相关数据丢失且不可恢复

DeleteVccRouteEntry.description_en: Delete a Lingjun connection route entry
DeleteVccRouteEntry.description_zh: 删除灵骏连接路由条目

DeleteVpd.description_en: After you delete a Lingjun CIDR block, the related data is lost and cannot be recovered
DeleteVpd.description_zh: 删除某个灵骏网段实例，删除后相关数据丢失且不可恢复

DeleteVpdGrantRule.description_en: Delete the Lingjun HUB cross-account authorization for a Lingjun CIDR block. After the deletion, the related data is lost and cannot be recovered
DeleteVpdGrantRule.description_zh: 删除某个灵骏网段的灵骏HUB跨账号授权，删除后相关数据丢失且不可恢复

DescribeSlr.description_en: Query whether the user has the SLR role-AliyunServiceRoleForEfloVcc required for Lingjun connection
DescribeSlr.description_zh: 查询用户是否存在灵骏连接需要的SLR角色-AliyunServiceRoleForEfloVcc

DetachElasticNetworkInterface.description_en: Detach an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) from a Lingjun node

GetDestinationCidrBlock.description_en: Users can use this API to query the destination CIDR block of the source policy instance when creating a routing strategy
GetDestinationCidrBlock.description_zh: 用户可用该API查询创建路由策略时，源策略实例的目的网段

GetElasticNetworkInterface.description_en: Retrieves the details of a Lingjun Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
GetElasticNetworkInterface.description_zh: 获取灵骏弹性网卡详情

GetErRouteEntry.description_en: Queries the details of Lingjun HUB route entries
GetErRouteEntry.description_zh: 查询灵骏HUB路由条目详情

GetErRouteMap.description_en: query lingjun hub routing policy details
GetErRouteMap.description_zh: 查询灵骏HUB路由策略详情信息

GetFabricTopology.description_en: Query the physical topology information of Lingjun network interface controller and Lingjun nodes under VPD
GetFabricTopology.description_zh: 查询VPD下灵骏网卡和灵骏节点的物理拓扑信息

GetLeniPrivateIpAddress.description_en: Retrieves detailed information about an auxiliary private IP address on a specified Lingjun Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
GetLeniPrivateIpAddress.description_zh: 获取指定灵骏弹性网卡辅助私网IP的详细信息

GetLniPrivateIpAddress.description_en: Obtains the details about the secondary private IP address
GetLniPrivateIpAddress.description_zh: 获取辅助私网IP详情信息

GetNetworkInterface.description_zh: 查询某张网卡实例信息

GetNodeInfoForPod.description_en: Queries the network information of a node
GetNodeInfoForPod.description_zh: 查询节点网络信息详情

GetSubnet.description_en: Queries the details of a Lingjun subnet, including the type, CIDR block, instance ID, instance status, and number of NCs
GetSubnet.description_zh: 查询某个灵骏子网的详细信息，包括灵骏子网类型，网络地址段，所属灵骏网段实例ID，实例状态，NC数量等

GetVcc.description_en: Queries the details of a Lingjun connection, including the specification, Express Connect circuit access port type, instance status, bandwidth, and BGP CIDR block
GetVcc.description_zh: 查询某个灵骏连接的详细信息，包括规格，物理专线接入端口类型，实例状态，带宽，BGP网段等

GetVccGrantRule.description_en: Queries the details of cross-account resource authorization for a Lingjun connection, including the authorized tenant ID, Lingjun HUB instance ID, and network instance ID
GetVccGrantRule.description_zh: 查询灵骏连接跨账号资源授权详情，包括授权租户ID，灵骏HUB实例ID，网络实例ID等

GetVpd.description_en: Queries the details of a Lingjun CIDR block, including the status of the Lingjun CIDR block, the CIDR block, the number of subnets and NCs
GetVpd.description_zh: 查询某个灵骏网段的详细信息，包括灵骏网段状态，Cidr地址，服务网段，Subnet及NC的数量等

GetVpdGrantRule.description_en: Queries the details of cross-account resource authorization for a Lingjun CIDR block, including the authorized tenant ID, Lingjun HUB instance ID, and network instance ID
GetVpdGrantRule.description_zh: 查询灵骏网段跨账号资源授权详情，包括授权租户ID，灵骏HUB实例ID，网络实例ID等

InitializeVcc.description_en: Initialize the Lingjun connection and authorize Intelligent Computing Lingjun to create an SLR in your account
InitializeVcc.description_zh: 初始化灵骏连接，授权智能计算灵骏在您的账号创建SLR

ListElasticNetworkInterfaces.description_en: Lists the Lingjun elastic network interfaces
ListElasticNetworkInterfaces.description_zh: 查询灵骏弹性网卡列表

ListErRouteEntries.description_en: Queries the route entries of the Lingjun HUB

ListInstancesByNcd.description_en: Queries the GPU node list of a specified GPU node whose communication distance does not exceed the specified NCD
ListInstancesByNcd.description_zh: 查询与指定GPU节点，通信距离不超过指定NCD的GPU节点列表

ListLeniPrivateIpAddresses.description_en: Lists the auxiliary private IP addresses assigned to the current Leni elastic network interface
ListLeniPrivateIpAddresses.description_zh: 查询当前灵骏弹性网卡辅助私网IP的列表信息

ListLniPrivateIpAddress.description_en: Queries the list of secondary private IP addresses of Lingjun network interface controller
ListLniPrivateIpAddress.description_zh: 查询当前灵骏网卡辅助私网IP的列表信息

ListNetworkInterfaces.description_zh: 查询灵骏网卡列表信息

ListSubnets.description_en: You can call this operation to query the details of one or more Lingjun subnets, including the Lingjun subnet type, network address segment, and instance ID of the Lingjun CIDR block
ListSubnets.description_zh: 查询一个或多个灵骏子网的详细信息，包括灵骏子网类型，网络地址段，所属灵骏网段实例ID等

ListVccFlowInfos.description_en: Queries the traffic rate of a Lingjun connection
ListVccFlowInfos.description_zh: 查询灵骏连接的流量速率信息

ListVccGrantRules.description_en: Queries the details of a Lingjun connection authorization, including the authorized tenant ID, region, and Lingjun HUB instance information
ListVccGrantRules.description_zh: 查询某个灵骏连接授权的详细信息，包括授权租户ID，地域，灵骏HUB实例信息等

ListVccRouteEntries.description_zh: 查询灵骏连接路由条目

ListVccs.description_en: query the details of one or more lingjun connections, including the specification, Express Connect circuit access port type, instance status, bandwidth, and bgp network segment
ListVccs.description_zh: 查询一个或多个灵骏连接的详细信息，包括规格，物理专线接入端口类型，实例状态，带宽，bgp网段等

ListVpdGrantRules.description_en: Queries the details of one or more route entries in the CIDR block of Lingjun, including the route type, route entry status, destination CIDR block, and instance information of the next route entry
ListVpdGrantRules.description_zh: 查询一个或多个灵骏网段路由条目的详细信息，包括路由类型，路由条目状态，目的网段，下一条的实例信息等

ListVpdRouteEntries.description_en: Queries the route entries of the Lingjun CIDR block
ListVpdRouteEntries.description_zh: 查询灵骏网段路由条目

ListVpds.description_en: Queries the details of one or more Lingjun CIDR blocks, including the status of Lingjun CIDR blocks, Cidr addresses, service CIDR blocks, and Subnet
ListVpds.description_zh: 查询一个或多个灵骏网段的详细信息，包括灵骏网段状态，Cidr地址，服务网段，Subnet等

QueryInstanceNcd.description_en: Query the network communication distance (Network Communication Distance,NCD) between instances (Lingjun node, Lingjun network interface controller)
QueryInstanceNcd.description_zh: 查询实例（灵骏节点、灵骏网卡）之间的网络通信距离（Network Communication Distance，NCD）

RefundVcc.description_zh: 使用本API可以退订一个预支付的灵骏连接

RetryVcc.description_en: Retry trying to create /delete a Lingjun connection
RetryVcc.description_zh: 重试尝试创建/删除灵骏连接

SwitchVccConnection.description_en: Switch the VCC connection instance or type
SwitchVccConnection.description_zh: 切换灵骏连接的连接实例包括：云企业网实例切换，专有网络实例切换，云企业网与专有网络实例的互相切换

UnAssignPrivateIpAddress.description_en: Deletes an assigned secondary private IP address
UnAssignPrivateIpAddress.description_zh: 将分配的辅助私网IP地址删除

UnAssociateVpdCidrBlock.description_en: This function can be used to delete the additional network segment of VPD
UnAssociateVpdCidrBlock.description_zh: 可通过此功能对VPD的附加网段进行删除

UnassignLeniPrivateIpAddress.description_en: Unassigns a secondary private IP address from a Lingjun elastic network interface (ENI)
UnassignLeniPrivateIpAddress.description_zh: 将分配的灵骏弹性网卡辅助私网IP删除

UpdateElasticNetworkInterface.description_en: Updates information for the Lingjun Elastic Network Interface
UpdateElasticNetworkInterface.description_zh: 更新灵骏弹性网卡信息

UpdateErRouteMap.description_en: Update some information about the routing policy, including the description and name of the routing policy
UpdateErRouteMap.description_zh: 更新路由策略的部分信息，包括路由策略的描述和名称

UpdateLeniPrivateIpAddress.description_en: Update the description of an auxiliary private IP address assigned to a Lingjun Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
UpdateLeniPrivateIpAddress.description_zh: 更新灵骏弹性网卡分配的辅助私网描述

UpdateSubnet.description_en: Updates some information about a specified subnet instance, including the name of the subnet instance
UpdateSubnet.description_zh: 更新灵骏子网实例的部分信息，包括灵骏子网实例名称

UpdateVcc.description_en: Updates the information about a Lingjun connection instance, including the peak bandwidth and name of the Lingjun connection instance
UpdateVcc.description_zh: 更新灵骏连接实例的部分信息，包括灵骏连接实例的带宽峰值和名称

UpdateVpd.description_en: Updates the information about the Lingjun CIDR block, including the name of the Lingjun CIDR block
UpdateVpd.description_zh: 更新灵骏网段实例的部分信息，包括灵骏网段实例的名称
